content.short: The TACF NFT Pilot Program is an effort to find alternative and sustainable funding methods for nonprofit.
content.description: In honor of its 20th Anniversary Global Concert Series, the Taki Alsop Conducting Fellowship (TACF) has released an NFT Pilot Program on the Cardano blockchain. This Program includes three series: The NFT Ticket Series and two Commemorative Photo Series, the former of which grants holders admission to one of the many TACF 20th Anniversary concerts taking place around the world through 2023. The TACF NFT Program is also an effort to bootstrap non-blockchain industries into the ecosystem.
content.meta: Find out about TACF NFT Pilot Program (TACF) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
